remarks: Welcome to Unit 1K, where the gentle combination of modern touches, warm ambiance and convenience provide the opportunity to enjoy living in this serene and beautiful space. The unit has been freshly updated, featuring new hardwood floors throughout, a cozy wood burning fireplace, two floors of ample modern living space, newly remodeled bathrooms, in unit laundry and a gorgeous vaulted ceiling primary bedroom with its own 4 piece en-suite and walk in closet. The kitchen is equipped with cabinet and counter space galore, a separate pantry closet and gas stove! Adding to the lovely features, the association provides beautifully maintained exterior grounds, outdoor elevator and two sets of stair case access to and from the lower level garage, an outdoor ramp, two assigned parking spaces and the ideal location close to shopping and other area's amenities. Good credit is a must.
